title: Video Editor (AI Video Generation)
description:
**Job Title:** **Video Editor (AI Video Generation)**

**Shift Time:** 7:00 am to 4 :30 pm

**Experience Required:** 2.5–4 years in video editing, ideally for social media or an agency

**About the role**

We are hiring a full-time video editor who makes scroll-stopping social videos and uses AI video tools as part of everyday work. You will edit Reels, Shorts and TikToks, build paid ad creatives for Meta and Google, and produce brand and promo videos for our clients.

This role suits someone who edits fast, understands what makes people stop scrolling in the first 3 seconds, and enjoys testing new AI tools to produce more variations in less time.

**Key responsibilities**

**Short-form social content**

* Edit 15–90 second Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikToks in vertical 9:16 format
* Add trending-style captions, text animations, sound design, transitions and music
* Write or adapt hooks so the first 3 seconds grab attention
* Repurpose long videos, podcasts and client footage into multiple short clips

**Paid ad creatives (Meta and Google)**

* Produce video ads in all key ratios: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9
* Create 3–5 variations per ad (different hooks, CTAs, music) for A/B testing
* Work with the ads team to read performance data and improve the next round of creatives
* Follow each platform's ad specs, safe zones and policy rules

**Brand and promo videos**

* Edit product launches, service explainers, testimonials and company promos
* Keep every video on-brand: fonts, colours, logo use and tone of voice
* Add motion graphics, lower thirds and simple 2D animations where needed

**AI video generation**

* Generate B-roll, product scenes and visual concepts with AI video tools
* Create AI voiceovers and avatar-based videos when real footage is not available
* Use AI for faster work: auto-captions, background removal, upscaling, clip selection
* Write clear prompts and keep a shared prompt library for the team
* Check all AI output for quality, brand fit and usage rights before delivery

**Workflow**

* Manage 15–25 edits per week across multiple clients without missing deadlines
* Handle feedback rounds and keep project files organised and named properly
* Keep up with social trends, formats and new AI tools, and share what works

**Required skills and experience**

* 2.5–4 years of professional video editing, with a strong portfolio of social media videos
* Hands-on experience with at least two AI video generation tools, with real samples to show
* Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, storytelling and hooks for short-form video
* Good knowledge of colour correction, audio cleanup and sound design
* Basic motion graphics and text animation skills
* Understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Meta ad formats and best practices
* Able to take feedback well and turn around revisions quickly
* Good written English for captions, prompts and client communication

**Nice to have**

* Agency experience handling several brands at once
* Experience making video for Australian, US or UK clients
* Basic shooting skills on phone or camera, including lighting and framing
* Knowledge of UGC-style ads and creator-style editing
* Basic Photoshop or Illustrator for thumbnails and covers

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Experience:

* International Client handling: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Solutions Expert - Technology
description:
### **Responsibilities**



Technology Leadership (OT \& Digital)


* Own OT and digital architecture across PLC, SCADA, DCS, IoT, Edge, Historians, AR/ VR, Computer Vision, MES, Digital Twin, Industrial AI, data and analytics platforms.
* Define and enforce technology standards, reference architectures, and lifecycle management practices.
* Act as the technology solutions expert for digital and automation initiatives.


Digital Transformation \& Use Case Enablement


* Translate business and operational requirements into robust digital solutions.
* Enable Industry 4\.0 use cases (MES, Digital Twin, AR/ VR, Computer Vision, Industrial AI) such as predictive maintenance, process optimization, quality and energy optimization.
* Support pilots, POCs and roll\-out in coordination with project and site teams.


OT Systems \& Cybersecurity


* Ensure availability, reliability and performance of OT systems.
* Define and implement OT cybersecurity controls aligned with ISA/IEC 62443\.
* Work very closely with the Cyber security Team and assist in patching and upgrades, backups and disaster recovery exercises for OT environments.


Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)


* HSE leadership and visible commitment
* Safety‑by‑design for OT \& digital systems
* Statutory and site compliance (PTW, commissioning, maintenance) – for project implementation, the candidate must provide clear guidance pertaining to safety requirements, to the Business Partner and their Team members.
* Contribute to Incident investigation and corrective actions as and when required.
* Use of digital technologies for safety and environmental monitoring


Project \& Delivery Collaboration


* Partner with Integral Project Managers to provide design, estimation and risk inputs.
* Review vendor proposals, solution design and ensure adherence to technology and security standards.
* Prepare technical updates and presentations, as necessary and directed by the Executive Leadership Team.


Stakeholder \& Vendor Management


* Act as primary technical interface between various stakeholders (mine/plant operations teams, Digital team, Group IT and technology partners).
* Evaluate and recommend technology platforms, OEMs and system integrators.
* Champion Change Management, so that applications that are rolled out are implemented in a flawless manner.

### **Qualifications**


* 15–20 years of experience in digital technology, process control and optimization roles.


* Strong experience in Metals, Mining, Process Manufacturing industries.


* Good knowledge in PLC, SCADA, DCS, OT–IT integration, IoT and industrial data platforms.


* Working knowledge of cloud platforms, data analytics and visualization.


* Experience supporting large\-scale digital or automation projects



Education \& Certifications • Bachelor’s/ master’s degree in engineering


* Certifications in OT, cybersecurity (ISA/IEC 62443\), digital or cloud platforms are desirable
